device: iPhone 18 Pro simulator (CrewCue wf_3d9ccde1-6b2-4, 361DCC99), iOS 27.0, Debug build; iPhone Duo simulator (CrewCue wf_3d9ccde1-6b2-4 Duo, 4A9BEB36), outer display only (folded, 466x678 pt). Earlier proof rounds (PR 753 to 9b) on other simulators are kept in the Duo and Adaptive notes.
commit: claude/ios-replay-follows-course: 159132a (the trail and dot follow the course line, the dot glides) and 3bd8799 (review fixes), on top of fb577bf
session: Replay-follows-course re-proof. Dev route crewcue://dev/onboarding-race-preview (DemoRaceFixture, no API), launched with simctl launch --deeplink, using ?at=<s>&paused=1 seeks and an unpaused ?at=5 run sampled with screenshots. Unit and UI tests: CrewCueTests (including GlideLayoutTests) plus OnboardingRacePreviewTests, FullWidthRowsTests and LaunchSplashTests passed with xcodebuild -only-testing. Reduce Motion: set with simctl spawn defaults write com.apple.Accessibility ReduceMotionEnabled and a reboot; the app reading it was not confirmed (see Accessibility labels). Not run: Duo inner display and a display switch mid-replay. The fold can't be driven by simctl or XCUITest, and the run had no access to the Simulator window, so this proof has the outer display only.
action: Replay on the fixture course (31.0 mi, Start, Aid 1 to Aid 3, Finish): the course drawn is the line the runner follows. Seeks at 0, 3, 6 and 9 s and an unpaused run from 5 s showed the dot gliding between pings along the course line (between Start and Aid 1, then toward Aid 2), with the dark trail starting at Start and ending exactly at the dot, never cutting a chord across the course. Paused at 9 s, a screenshot 5 s later was byte-identical (the dot held). The path chip read PATH 1 POINT, 7, 10 points as pings arrived and 21 POINTS late in the replay: it counts pings, not the added points.

checked.Success: Compact (iPhone 18 Pro, Duo outer display, Pro Max portrait): one view at a time following the beats with a Map/Pace/Chat strip. Captions '1 of 4' to '4 of 4'. Last ping: just now / 3 min ago / 18 min ago / just now. Map footer 'Next aid station Finish 7:50 PM'. Pace: Aid 1 and Aid 2 rows 'Locked', note 'Aid station times stay locked until you unlock the race.' Chat: 'Your crew 5:32 PM, Saw your pings come back in. We'll be ready at the next aid.' with no message field, no send button and no photo picker. Paywall: 'You + 1 crew' with 'Buy Race Pass, $14.99' and 'Your whole crew' with 'Buy Race Pass + Full Crew, $19.99', Redeem code and Not now. After Not now: tab bar with Unlock race. After a debug purchase: tab bar, no Unlock race, race paid. Fix round: the UI test reads the live finish ETA at beat 1 and sees it change at beat 2, waits for '18 min ago' in the dead zone, and asserts no crewcue.chat-message or crewcue.chat-send in the replay's Chat.
checked.Empty: Not run on a real race: a race with no course never reaches the replay gate (setup needs the course). The Empty state on the real screen is covered by OnboardingRacePreviewTests with ?state=empty.
checked.Error: Covered by OnboardingRacePreviewTests with ?state=error ('Couldn't play the replay. Skip to unlock your race.'); not reproduced against the API.
checked.Offline: API unreachable, new runner with no saved room: 'Offline. The replay plays from the race saved on this phone.' with Skip, and Skip opened the paywall.
checked.Accessibility labels: crewcue.onboarding-race-preview, .caption, .play-pause, .skip, .status, crewcue.onboarding-paywall, .runner-plus-one(.buy), .full-crew(.buy), .back, .not-now, crewcue.map, crewcue.runner-track, crewcue.schedule-sheet, crewcue.live-eta, crewcue.chat Reduce Motion: the defaults key was set to 1 and the simulator rebooted; in a sampled run the dot stayed at one place between pings, but that run was in the dead zone too, so stepping was not told apart from the glide. Not proved.
checked.Adaptive: Compact: one pane. Regular (Pro Max landscape): Map and Pace side by side (about 600 pt each), Chat replacing Map at its beat; the rotation from portrait beat 2 to landscape kept beat 2 and the 8:02 PM finish, and continued to the dead zone (Last ping 14 min ago, finish '8:02 PM old ping') and the chat. Duo outer display: the caption card and clock/camera area kept clear on the right, one pane. Temporary files: the app container tmp held no crewcue-demo-* directory on any of the three simulators after the runs (finish, Skip, Not now, purchase and a kill mid-replay all swept). Not run: Duo inner display and a Duo display switch (see session). Fix round re-check: Pro Max landscape (regular width) on the dev route, beats 1 to 3: Map pane (478 pt) beside Pace, the Map's status and ping chips, Path chip and Fit course inside the Map pane's trailing edge (Fit course at x 410-462 of 478), the course from Aid 1 to the finish framed between the chip row and the aid sheet with the shrunk replay padding, Pace with Aid 1 to 3 'Locked' and no aid ETA, and at beat 3 'LAST PING: 18 MIN AGO' with 'Finish ETA 1:02 PM · old ping'. The Pro Max has no division region, so the reserved-region insets on the Map's overlays are a no-op there; the Duo inner display is still not run. Paid race Map tab (dev session, local memory API, paid race, iPhone 18 Pro portrait and landscape): framed with the race padding unchanged from main (no shrink): portrait course from the top chips down to the sheet, no Unlock race banner; landscape keeps the full padding, so the course stays zoomed out exactly as on main.
checked.Duo: Outer display (466x678 pt, display 1) at ?at=9&paused=1: caption card with the clock and camera area clear on the right, Map with the dot on the line near Aid 1 and the trail ending at it, PATH 10 POINTS. Not run on this build: the inner display and a switch between the two displays mid-replay (the inner display screenshot was black while folded; the fold needs the Simulator window). The earlier inner display and display switch results on fe9673d are in the earlier proof rounds above and were not repeated.
checked.Replay trail: Standard iPhone: the trail ends at the dot at every sampled moment; the dot sits on the drawn course line; between two pings the dot moved to positions that are not ping positions (glide), seen in six consecutive frames of an unpaused run. Paused: the dot and chips did not change over 5 s. The fixture course is nearly straight between aids, so a chord and the line are close on this fixture; the unit tests (demoRaceServedPathLiesOnTheCourseLineAndFollowsIt, demoRaceFollowingBeatServesAPointAtLeastEvery150Meters, GlideLayoutTests) carry the line-following check, the screenshots show no corner cut.
